answer: A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The voyage counter is kept in violet and mesa shows each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1703 identities would post 1827 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
